details.description: gpt-4-0125-preview is the January 25, 2024 snapshot of OpenAI's GPT-4 Turbo preview series. OpenAI released it to complete tasks such as code generation more thoroughly than the earlier November 2023 (1106) preview, reducing cases where that snapshot left a task unfinished -- behavior widely described at the time as the model being 'lazy.' It offers a 128K-token context window with text-only input and output, through the chat completions API. OpenAI's deprecations page lists this snapshot as shut down on March 26, 2026, recommending gpt-5 or gpt-4.1 as replacements, and Azure's current GPT-4 documentation no longer lists it as an active snapshot, having folded all 2023-era GPT-4 preview snapshots into the GA gpt-4 (turbo-2024-04-09) release.
advantages: OpenAI released it specifically to complete tasks like code generation more thoroughly, reducing instances where the prior (1106) preview left a task unfinished.
Offers a 128K-token context window, per OpenAI's model documentation.
disadvantages: Shut down by OpenAI on March 26, 2026, per OpenAI's deprecations page, which recommends gpt-5 or gpt-4.1 as replacements.
Azure's current GPT-4 documentation lists the GA gpt-4 (turbo-2024-04-09) release as the replacement for all previous GPT-4 preview models, including this one.
Text-only input and output -- no image/vision support in this snapshot, per OpenAI's model documentation.
use_cases: Chat and text-generation tasks requiring a 128K-token context window
Code-generation tasks needing more complete, less-truncated output than the prior preview snapshot
